purpose: Mark an activity as in progress during its duration.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
We are currently in a meeting.
This entrance cannot be used because construction is underway.
Please put your phone away during class.
restrictions: For all of a time span, 中 may be read じゅう; this point concerns ongoing activities.
mistake: 会議中 means during a meeting, not necessarily all day.
